name: @bpmiq/bpmn-edit
description: BPMN editing through bpmn-moddle (ADR 0008): a compact outline, semantic edit operations, automatic layout and layout metrics — a platform-free design core plus optional Camunda 7 / Camunda 8 implement adapters. ISOMORPHIC: the same operations run in the live host and in the browser.
//: The exported entries are browser-safe (CI-enforced: `pnpm arch`, rule bpmn-edit-stays-isomorphic). src/main.ts is the ONLY Node entry and is deliberately not exported.
